title: memory-passport memory file frontmatter
description: Frontmatter for a single memory file in a memory-passport vault (spec 0.1).

name.description: Human-readable name of the subject this file is about.

description.description: One line summarising the file, used by assistants to decide whether to load it.

items.description: Product identifier, lower-case kebab-case, e.g. chatgpt, claude, claude-code, cursor, gemini, hermes, manual.

sources.description: Products whose memory contributed to this file.

aliases.description: Other names the subject is known by.

updated.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which any fact line last changed.

kind.description: What sort of subject this file describes. Must agree with the file's path.
